target_customer: Consumers who want an AI fitness and nutrition coach inside iMessage
problem: Calorie and workout tracking apps demand manual logging and do not act on the user's behalf.
business_model: Consumer subscription or freemium AI agent (basic service currently free)
product_category: Consumer AI agent, fitness and nutrition coaching

founders.name: Manil Lakabi
founders.background_notes: Education not listed on the YC page. Sole founder named by YC.

technical_complexity.rationale: Photo to calorie estimation uses off the shelf vision models and an iMessage interface; the harder agent actions are planned rather than shipped.

defensibility.rationale: Many photo calorie apps launched in 2024 (CalorieAI, Calorielens, Bite AI) so the core feature is copyable in weeks; personal context could add lock in later.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Lifesum added multimodal photo and voice logging; later iMessage based competitors such as Tomo and Brodie appeared; no acquisition of Biblo found.

market_need_then: Photo calorie apps proliferated through 2024, showing consumer demand for lower effort logging; no Biblo specific usage numbers were found.

branding.domain_note: Uses heybiblo.com, a prefix domain, rather than biblo.com.

identity.logo: Small grinning icon beside the name
identity.visual_style: Light, playful with hearts and stars

brand_strength.rationale: A short friendly name and consistent casual voice, but no press or community evidence and other companies named Biblo exist.

outcome_analysis: Biblo is an active seven person YC F24 company building an iMessage fitness agent. No funding round, revenue or exit was found and no press mentions of the company appeared in search, so the outcome is undetermined. The feature set is easy to copy and iMessage agent rivals emerged in 2026.
notes: The YC page lists founded year 2026 while the batch is Fall 2024; the inconsistency is unresolved so founded_year is null. Searches for funding and brand returned nothing about Biblo, so funding is none_found and brand details are mostly null. Competitor search found 2024 dated photo calorie apps (CalorieAI Feb 2024, Calorielens Jun 2024, Bite AI Nov 2024) from Product Hunt and app store listings but they are generic and none was opened, so the list is empty. Technical flag is null because the YC page does not say.
